steps.instructions: Say: We will now simulate a soft credit check using a fictional record. No bureau will be contacted and your credit is not affected by this demo. Ask permission to continue. Explain no Social Security digits are required; use the configured identity_check placeholder. If permission is refused, do not proceed; stop the demo.
steps.result: Demo conversation checkpoint completed; no real financial action.

steps.instructions: Say: Perfect. Please give me a moment to retrieve our demo information. I will place you on a brief hold while I check it. Then complete this step to fetch the report. Stay silent during the request. Do not claim a report or plan exists before the tool succeeds. If unavailable, explain and request staff help; never fabricate a report. This is a spoken hold, not hold music.
steps.result: Demo conversation checkpoint completed; no real financial action.

steps.instructions: Use ONLY the report returned by the hold tool. Say: Hi, I am back on the line. I have the demo report here. Let us go over your accounts together. I am showing [accounts_count] accounts totaling [debts_total]. Read the returned creditors and balances, ask whether they are correct, and wait. The enrollment selection is simulated and internal; do not claim real approval or enrollment.
steps.result: Demo conversation checkpoint completed; no real financial action.

steps.instructions: Ask: Looking at all of this together, how did you get into this debt with your creditors? STOP speaking. After their answer call complete with quote containing their EXACT words, not a summary. The tool waits for three seconds of quiet; do not fill that silence. If they add a second sentence, include it in the quote and retry. Never use a dummy pain statement. After saved, say: I appreciate you sharing that. I can see why that would put pressure on you. Explain this demo section is complete and stop; do not continue to sales, contracts or payment.
steps.result: Demo conversation checkpoint completed; no real financial action.
